The `invalid_grant: Token has been expired or revoked` is now hitting for the 5th consecutive morning. This silently degrades every downstream brief — no calendar events, no email digest, no Drive/Sheets/Docs reads. recommendations.action: At the top of the morning brief, prompt Chris clearly: 'Open the reauth link in Chrome Incognito as madeat2am.ai@gmail.com, approve all scopes, copy the full redirect URL from the address bar, paste it back here.'
